integrity: Complete proof is elementary and all-depth; standard-library finite checker tests its boundary cases but is not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts increasing integral progressions in ternary cutoffs of indices with Motzkin numbers nonzero modulo three; no assertion for other primes or arbitrary finite patterns. Classical digit characterization is credited to Deutsch and Sagan; no independent publication-priority certification.
title: Exact arithmetic-progression spectra at ternary Motzkin nondivisibility indices
